verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents a public REST API with an OpenAPI specification, and the probe confirms a live openapi.json. It also ships official CLIs (the instance CLI and @lobehub/market-cli / lhm), so developers can build against it programmatically. However, no official language SDK or client library is evidenced, so users must generate or hand-write clients from the spec. Missing for 10: official language SDKs (e.g. JS/Python client packages), SDK reference docs, and independent corroboration of developer use.
